mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, m.user_name AS userName, m.email AS email, m.created_at AS createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board b WHERE b.user_id = m.user_id ) AS boardCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_reply r WHERE r.user_id = m.user_id ) AS replyCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_like l WHERE l.user_id = m.user_id ) AS likeCount FROM members m ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
